title: Gift Budget Burn Rate by Occasion
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=giftbudget:item
| search spend_amount=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(spend_amount) as spend_amount avg(budget_remaining) as avg_budget_remaining by _time occasion
| sort - _time
description: Tracks gift-budget burn rate over time and breaks it out by occasion.
value: Burn rate by occasion is the easiest way to spot a celebration getting expensive too early.
implementation: Send gift-budget burn rate events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of gift-budget burn rate by occasion.
grandmaExplanation: It records how gift-budget burn rate changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
